Yaum Magic

Bring your Moxfield deck or grab any precon, then play bots or friends online in 2 to 4 player Commander.

1Your deck

On Moxfield, choose More → Export → Copy plain text. Mark your commander with a Commander header or *CMDR*.

2Opponents

Each campaign is set in one Commander release: three duels that get harder, then a boss with a deck built from that set. Progress is saved to your profile.

Host a game

Everyone needs this same file (or the same web page). The host picks the seats and rules; each player picks their own deck.

Card art and rules load from Scryfall and the Forge project, so you need an internet connection.
